stories.title: Maricarmen y las elecciones del 29-N, en directo | Ayuso vuelve a poner en duda el voto por correo: “Sánchez va a intentar hacer todas las trampas que pueda”

en.title: Maricarmen and the 29-N elections, live | Ayuso again questions mail-in voting: "Sánchez will try to commit all the fraud he can"
en.summary: Spanish political parties began campaigning for November 29 elections, with PP leaders holding an event in Madrid and PSOE's Sánchez campaigning in Seville. ERC and Bildu announced they will run together in Senate races.

stories.title: Ucrania golpea una gran terminal petrolera rusa tras el acuerdo del diésel de Trump y Putin

en.title: Ukraine strikes major Russian oil terminal after Trump and Putin diesel agreement
en.summary: Ukraine attacked a Russian oil terminal following an announced agreement between Trump and Putin regarding Russian diesel. The U.S. president publicized a measure that Russia was already preparing to implement.

stories.title: Trump anuncia un acuerdo con Putin para que EE.UU. reciba diésel de Rusia

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Putin for U.S. to receive diesel from Russia
en.summary: The U.S. president announced an agreement with Russia's leader to supply millions of tons of diesel to American and global markets to reduce prices, addressing concerns among Republican allies about high fuel costs.

stories.title: Ucrania ataca una terminal petrolera rusa horas después del acuerdo alcanzado entre Trump y Putin para liberar diésel ruso

en.title: Ukraine attacks Russian oil terminal hours after agreement reached between Trump and Putin to release Russian diesel
en.summary: Ukraine struck a Russian oil terminal shortly after Trump and Putin reached a diesel-related agreement. A separate Russian attack on the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhia resulted in multiple casualties.

stories.title: Yuval Abraham, director de 'NAZA': «Tengo menos miedo del Gobierno de Israel que de la gente que azuza contra nosotros»

en.title: Yuval Abraham, director of 'NAZA': "I have less fear of the Israeli Government than of the people inciting against us"
en.summary: Israeli filmmakers behind documentary 'NAZA' faced political backlash after its Venice premiere, with government officials threatening citizenship revocation and legal action. The directors decided not to return to Israel.

stories.title: Un año de alto el fuego sin paz en Gaza: “Los niños siguen sufriendo amputaciones”

en.title: A year of ceasefire without peace in Gaza: "Children continue to suffer amputations"
en.summary: Israel's military operations beyond agreed lines have confined over two million Palestinians to one-third of Gaza territory, with children experiencing ongoing injuries.

stories.title: Un año de alto el fuego en Gaza con casi 1.500 muertos

en.title: A year of ceasefire in Gaza with nearly 1,500 deaths
en.summary: Israel continues daily bombardments and blocks reconstruction efforts affecting two million people. After receiving final hostages from Hamas, the truce has been stripped of substantive content amid US silence and Peace Board inaction.

stories.title: La Cabra, la cafetería de especialidad más copiada del mundo, aterriza en España

en.title: La Cabra, the world's most copied specialty café, lands in Spain
en.summary: Danish specialty coffee company La Cabra has opened its first café location in Madrid, situated within a historic jewelry shop.

stories.title: La Cabra, la cafetería danesa de reconocimiento internacional, aterriza en Madrid con una experiencia multisensorial en torno al café y al pan

en.title: La Cabra, the internationally recognized Danish café, lands in Madrid with a multisensory coffee and bread experience
en.summary: La Cabra has opened a minimalist design café in Madrid's Chueca neighborhood featuring light roast coffee from Colombia, Ethiopia, and Kenya, alongside fresh daily baked goods and pastries.

stories.title: Trump acuerda con Putin el suministro de diésel ruso a los mercados mundiales

en.title: Trump agrees with Putin on Russian diesel supply to world markets
en.summary: The U.S. president announced an agreement with Moscow for the immediate release of Russian diesel to global markets in phased shipments totaling millions of tons.

stories.title: Trump llega a un acuerdo con Putin para que Rusia libere miles de barriles de diésel en los mercados mundiales

en.title: Trump reaches agreement with Putin for Russia to release thousands of barrels of diesel into world markets
en.summary: Trump and Putin have agreed on a deal involving Russian diesel releases into global markets, announced weeks before elections as fuel prices impact Republican electoral prospects.

stories.title: Yuval Abraham, director de 'Naza': “¿Cómo es posible verse a uno mismo como una buena persona y participar en la matanza en Gaza?”

en.title: Yuval Abraham, director of 'Naza': "How is it possible to see oneself as a good person and participate in the slaughter in Gaza?"
en.summary: The film director, who has received threats from the Israeli government, states that most Israeli society either ignores or justifies the genocide of Palestinian civilians.

stories.title: Putin confirma el acuerdo con Trump para el suministro de crudo a EEUU y al mercado mundial

en.title: Putin confirms agreement with Trump for crude supply to the US and world market
en.summary: Russia's President Putin confirmed an agreement reached with US President Trump regarding Russian petroleum supply to American and global markets.

stories.title: JTI acelera en tabaco calentado: "En 10 años su presencia será enorme"

en.title: JTI accelerates in heated tobacco: "In 10 years its presence will be enormous"
en.summary: Japanese tobacco company JTI, which owns Camel and Winston brands, is expanding its heated tobacco business and plans to invest 4.5 billion euros through 2028 in these alternative products.

en.title: Europe seeks support
en.summary: Paris stock exchange has declined 12 percent from its August peak levels.

stories.title: El coche eléctrico acelera en España: estos son los más vendidos

en.title: Electric cars accelerate in Spain: these are the best sellers
en.summary: Electric passenger vehicles are experiencing the fastest growth in Spain, surpassing 100,000 units registered during the first nine months of the year.

stories.title: Josh Payne, el minero australiano que conquistó a los gigantes de la IA

en.title: Josh Payne, the Australian miner who conquered AI giants
en.summary: An Australian miner backed by Sheryl Sandberg and Jensen Huang aims to develop Nscale into a hyperscaler valued at one trillion dollars.
